beats.en: A mixture is made of two or more substances that are mixed together but not chemically joined, like poha, salad or air.
beats.speakEn: A mixture is made of two or more substances that are mixed together but not chemically joined, like poha, salad or air.

textbookBox.concept: A pure substance has only one kind of particle and a fixed composition, such as water or iron.

beats.en: A pure substance has only one kind of particle and a fixed composition, such as water or iron.
beats.speakEn: A pure substance has only one kind of particle and a fixed composition, such as water or iron.

beats.en: An element is a pure substance that cannot be broken into simpler substances by chemical methods; examples are hydrogen, oxygen, iron and gold.
